tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, integrations, and database performance tuning. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer experienced in working within international Agile teams.

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant position at Techwave Hungary. With over 5 years of professional experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in complex e-commerce implementations and enterprise integrations.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Implementation
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: APIs and Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and integrated external services through the SAP Commerce Cloud Portal, while resolving integration bottlenecks between ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms.

bullets.label: International Project Experience
bullets.text: Worked directly with international technical teams and stakeholders across multiple enterprise projects, analyzing requirements and translating them into robust SAP Commerce Cloud solutions.

bullets.label: Cloud & Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), managed platform operations through the HAC, and performed code reviews and production troubleshooting.

cover_en.gap: While my projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell involved deep integration work with SAP ERP and Profisee PIM, I have not yet directly worked with SAP S/4HANA integration, but I am very keen to learn it.
cover_en.logistics: I am currently based in Karlsruhe, Germany, and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, making me available to start from 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with Techwave Hungary.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at Techwave because of its commitment to digital transformation and fostering a culture of growth and inclusivity across international projects. Your focus on delivering complex SAP solutions to global clients resonates strongly with my 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, solid Java and Spring skills, and a history of international project delivery, I am eager to contribute to Techwave's innovative e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise Hybris solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I noticed Techwave's opening for an SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant and would love to connect about the role. Best regards, Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant position at Techwave Hungary.

With over 5 years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development, Java, Spring, and enterprise system integrations for global platforms, I am confident in my ability to contribute effectively to your international project team.

I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
